title: Cloning VMs

# Cloning VMs {#virt-cloning-vms}

You can clone virtual machines (VMs) or create new VMs from snapshots.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> Cloning a VM with a vTPM device attached to it or creating a new VM from its snapshot is not supported.
